wolfram.note: Both decline on an empty collection: compute-engine answers Missing, Wolfram's Last[{}] stays unevaluated.

Last[1/b]: Wolfram's FullForm of 1/b is Power[b,-1], so Last gives -1 (the exponent). Our canonical form for division is a genuine Divide(1,b) with operands [1,b], so Last gives b. Both are internally consistent with their own canonical representation of division; structure-sensitive heads like Last necessarily disagree as a result.
